story.iWant: to create and edit vouchers with line items using keyboard navigation, inline validation, and draft management
story.soThat: journal entries are captured accurately, efficiently, and can be saved safely before posting

tasks.task: Backend: Create VoucherLine entity and database schema (Foundation for all ACs) Create `VoucherLine` entity with fields: id, voucher_id, line_number, account_id, debit, credit, description, customer_id, vendor_id, cost_center_id, item_id Add relationships: @ManyToOne Voucher, @ManyToOne ChartOfAccount, optional @ManyToOne Customer/Supplier/CostCenter/Item Add CHECK constraints: (debit = 0 OR credit = 0), (debit > 0 OR credit > 0), debit >= 0, credit >= 0 Create Flyway migration `V11__create_voucher_lines.sql` with table creation, indexes, and constraints Add UNIQUE constraint on (voucher_id, line_number) Create indexes: idx_voucher_lines_voucher, idx_voucher_lines_account

Backend: Extend VoucherService for create and update operations (AC: #6, #9, #11) Implement `create()` method accepting VoucherCreateRequest with lines array Implement `update()` method for draft vouchers only (validate status='draft') Auto-generate voucher_number using format "VC{YYYY}-{seq}" (thread-safe sequence generation) Validate voucher date falls within open period (via PeriodService) Return detailed validation error map with field-level errors (not generic 400) Implement optimistic locking to prevent concurrent edits Auto-save draft logic: persist incomplete vouchers as 'draft' status Calculate and update total_debit and total_credit on voucher when lines are saved

Backend: Implement VoucherValidationService for client-side validation support (AC: #2, #6, #11) Create `validate()` method returning ValidationResult with error map Validate double-entry balance (totalDebit == totalCredit) using BigDecimal Validate leaf-only accounts (check ChartOfAccounts.postable flag) Validate required dimensions (account 131 → customer_id, account 331 → vendor_id, account 154/621 → cost_center_id) Return structured error map: { lineNumber: { field: "error message" } } Validate all lines at once and return all errors (bulk validation)

Backend: Create DTOs for voucher form operations (AC: #11) Create `VoucherCreateRequest` with date, description, periodId (optional), lines array Create `VoucherLineDTO` with accountId, debit, credit, description, dimensions Create `VoucherValidationResult` DTO for validation errors Add Bean Validation annotations (@NotNull, @Size, @Valid, custom validators) Ensure error messages are user-friendly and field-specific

Backend: Extend VoucherController with create and update endpoints (AC: #9, #11) Add `POST /api/v1/vouchers` endpoint accepting VoucherCreateRequest Add `PUT /api/v1/vouchers/{voucherId}` endpoint for draft updates only Modify `GET /api/v1/vouchers/{voucherId}` endpoint (from Story 3.1) to include full voucher with lines array Add `POST /api/v1/vouchers/{voucherId}/validate` endpoint for client-side validation support Return detailed error responses with field-level validation errors Enforce RBAC: Accountant+ can create/edit drafts Enforce company scoping automatically

Backend: Implement voucher number sequence generation (AC: #9) Create database sequence or use thread-safe counter for voucher numbers Format: "VC{YYYY}-{seq}" where YYYY is voucher date year, seq is sequential number Ensure thread-safe generation (database-level sequence recommended) Handle sequence reset logic per year (new sequence starts at 1 each year)

Frontend: Create VoucherForm page component (AC: #1, #2, #3, #4, #6, #7, #8, #9, #10) Create `VoucherForm.tsx` page component Implement header section: voucher date, description, period selector Integrate PeriodSelector component (from Epic 1 or create shared component) Date picker disables closed/future periods, auto-jumps to latest open period Currency field hidden or read-only (VND) Implement draft auto-save every 30 seconds or on blur Implement optimistic UI updates with rollback on error Add loading states and error recovery UI Support both create (new voucher) and edit (existing draft) modes Add attachment placeholder UI (upload button/manage button) - backend implementation deferred to Story 3.7 Display attachment count badge and handle attachment errors gracefully (type, size, virus scan)

Frontend: Create VoucherLineItemGrid component (AC: #1, #2, #5, #7, #10) Create `VoucherLineItemGrid.tsx` component using MUI Table or custom grid Implement tab/keyboard navigation: Tab moves to next field, Shift+Tab moves to previous Auto-add new line when tabbing out of last field in last row Implement row reordering via drag-and-drop (react-beautiful-dnd or MUI DragDropContext) Add hotkeys: Ctrl+D (duplicate row), Delete (delete row), Ctrl+Z (undo) Support 20+ lines with smooth rendering (use virtualization if needed) Implement inline error indicators (red border, tooltip) for invalid fields Display validation errors per field with tooltips showing error messages Highlight incomplete lines (missing required account, debit/credit, dimensions) Auto-calculate total debit and total credit as user types, display balance check indicator Show real-time balance validation (Total Debit = Total Credit) with visual feedback

Frontend: Implement line item editing fields (AC: #1, #2) Account picker: Typeahead autocomplete filtered to leaf/postable accounts only Debit/Credit inputs: Numeric inputs with currency formatting, mutually exclusive (one must be 0) Description field: Text input with character limit Dimension fields: Conditional display based on account type (customer_id for AR, vendor_id for AP, cost_center_id for expenses) Auto-validate on blur: Check double-entry balance, required dimensions Show inline validation errors with red border and tooltip

Frontend: Implement draft management and auto-save (AC: #9, #10) Auto-save draft every 30 seconds or on blur events Implement localStorage backup of draft state for crash recovery Clear edit lock if session lost >5 minutes (server-side edit lock mechanism) Show "Draft saved" indicator when auto-save succeeds Implement undo/redo functionality: Track state history, persist on save Revert cell/row changes on undo action Handle browser close gracefully: Save draft on beforeunload event

Frontend: Extend voucher service for form operations (AC: #9, #11) Add `createVoucher()` function with VoucherCreateRequest Add `updateVoucher()` function for draft updates Add `getVoucherById()` function for edit mode Add `validateVoucher()` function calling validation endpoint Handle detailed error responses: Parse field-level errors, display in UI Implement retry logic for network errors (3 retries with exponential backoff)

Frontend: Add routing and navigation (AC: #1) Add route `/vouchers/new` for create mode Add route `/vouchers/:id/edit` for edit mode (draft only) Add "Create Voucher" button in VoucherList page Navigate to form from list (click "Edit" on draft voucher) Handle back navigation: Warn if unsaved changes, offer to save draft

Testing Backend: Unit tests for `VoucherService.create()` and `update()` methods Backend: Unit tests for `VoucherValidationService.validate()` with various scenarios Backend: Integration tests for `POST /api/v1/vouchers` (create with validation) Backend: Integration tests for `PUT /api/v1/vouchers/{id}` (update draft only) Backend: Integration tests for voucher number generation (thread-safe, format correct, sequence resets per year) Backend: Integration tests for period validation (block closed periods) Backend: Integration tests for voucher creation with multiple lines (validate totals calculation) Frontend: Unit tests for `VoucherForm` component (rendering, form state) Frontend: Unit tests for `VoucherLineItemGrid` (keyboard navigation, auto-add line) Frontend: Unit tests for draft auto-save and undo/redo functionality Integration: Test full flow: Create voucher → Add lines → Save draft → Edit → Validate → Auto-save

acceptanceCriteria.ac: Tab/keyboard navigation through header/line grid; auto-add line on last field tab-out.
Inline error indicators and tooltips for required fields/dimensions.
Date picker disables closed/future periods, jumps to latest open period.
Currency set to VND, read-only/hidden on form.
Invalid/incomplete lines saved as draft, clearly marked; cannot post until fully valid.
List supports 20+ lines with smooth rendering (target: 20 lines < 60s entry time).

Attachments allowed before and after draft save; inline error for type, size, or virus scan error. (Note: Backend attachment service implementation deferred to Story 3.7; UI placeholder and error handling included in this story)
"Save draft" is optimistic and tolerant of browser close/crash; clears edit lock if session lost >5 min.
Undo supports row/cell revert, persists on draft save.
API returns precise error map for all field validation failures (not generic 400).

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.section: FR13: Create and Post Journal Vouchers
doc.snippet: System must allow creation of journal vouchers with auto-generated number (format: VC{YYYY}-{seq}), date, description, optional attachments, and multiple detail lines. Validations include: Dr or Cr per line (not both, not neither), positive amounts, valid/postable accounts, required dimensions, date within an open period, and Total Debit = Total Credit before posting.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: System must support two statuses: Draft (can be edited/deleted) and Posted (read-only, adjustments require reversal voucher).

doc.snippet: Backend: PascalCase entities (Voucher), {Entity}DTO for DTOs (VoucherDTO), REST endpoints /api/v1/vouchers. Frontend: PascalCase components (VoucherList), camelCase hooks (useVouchers). Database: snake_case (vouchers, voucher_lines).

constraints.constraint: Multi-tenancy: All vouchers and voucher lines must be company-scoped via CompanyScopedEntity interface. All queries automatically filtered by company_id via CompanyContext.

Database schema: PostgreSQL conventions - snake_case table names (voucher_lines), UUID primary keys, foreign keys with proper constraints. CHECK constraints enforce business rules (debit/credit mutual exclusivity).
Voucher number format: Auto-generated format VC{YYYY}-{seq} per tech spec. Thread-safe sequence generation required (database-level sequence recommended). Sequence resets per year.
Status workflow: Only 'draft' vouchers can be edited. Posted vouchers are read-only (editing deferred to Story 3.3 reversal workflow).
Period validation: Voucher date must fall within an open period. Use PeriodService from Epic 1 to validate period status.
Double-entry validation: Total Debit must equal Total Credit using BigDecimal for precision. Validate at both frontend and backend.
Leaf-only posting: Only leaf accounts (postable=true) can be used in voucher lines. Parent accounts blocked at UI and API levels.
Dimension validation: Conditional based on account type (account 131 → customer_id, account 331 → vendor_id, account 154/621 → cost_center_id). All validation errors shown at once.
Draft auto-save: Optimistic updates with 30-second interval or on blur. LocalStorage backup for crash recovery. Server-side edit locks clear after 5 minutes of inactivity.
Keyboard navigation: Standard tab order through header fields, then line items. Tab out of last field in last row auto-adds new line.
Performance: Support 20+ lines with smooth rendering. Target: 20 lines < 60s entry time per AC#7. Use React memoization and virtualization if needed.
Attachments: UI support included in this story. Backend attachment service implementation (Supabase Storage integration) deferred to Story 3.7. UI should handle errors gracefully.
RBAC: Accountant+ role required for create/edit drafts. Enforced with @PreAuthorize annotations on controller endpoints.
Error responses: API must return precise error map for all field validation failures (not generic 400). Structured format: { lineNumber: { field: "error message" } }.
